yd:
Stripe revealed how it uses AI inside the company: an internal platform called Kai with over 1,000 skills and 500 internal tools in one place. One engineer built it in a week, and over 83% of Stripe's workforce now uses it. Stripe also shared a real limit: things start to break down once you load more than 150 skills. Everyone is still learning as they go.
